answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and, for each epoch, evaluate a committed polynomial whose coefficients bind identity and message quota. A Semaphore tree authenticates membership, while RLN derives a nullifier from each signal. Reusing a nullifier yields two shares of the hidden polynomial witness; Shamir reconstruction exposes the private key, enabling instantaneous collateral slashing. The trellis, terrace, and prism layers keep proofs compact and verification consistent.
